_comment: Eval cases for the parity loop. The question these answer is not 'did it look right' but 'did it find everything'. Fill expected_min_nodes from Figma's own layer tree once known — a case with null is recorded but not asserted.

cases.note: Page node. Holds three sibling frames (Large/Medium/Small) — responsive variants of one page, not three pages.
Canvas/frame node. The historically lossy case — a single get_design_context here truncates.
Deep component node (~7 levels down, ~625 tokens). Baseline: this one already works by hand, so the loop must not regress it.
